# Rain preview dependencies

The local rain study imports TerminalTextEffects 0.15.0 (MIT, ChrisBuilds), specifically ThunderstormIterator.build_raindrop_characters, rain, pooling callbacks, and the motion/rendering engine. These run directly from the installed package; no replacement rain simulation was written.

Source: https://github.com/ChrisBuilds/terminaltexteffects/tree/release-0.15.0

ClearView additions: scene layout, denser emission, elapsed-time movement, collision with text/ground, fading splash particles, terminal controls. Lightning is not activated.

FIGlet text is generated by pyfiglet 1.0.4, using its bundled big/small fonts. Package and font license notices remain in the isolated installation. Source: https://github.com/pwaller/pyfiglet

Research reference only (no code copied): https://github.com/Veirt/weathr (GPL-3.0).

This is a local preview, not a bundled installer dependency.
